error.invalid_json: The robot did not understand the request.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.none.title: Calibrate your robot
calibration.none.text: You will set how far each axis may travel and where the wand rests. Stay next to the robot: during Calibration it can go beyond its usual limits, slowly. Remove the wand's toy if it could hit something.
calibration.horizontal_min.title: Horizontal: first end
calibration.horizontal_min.text: Nudge the arm toward one end of its horizontal travel. Stop just before anything touches or strains, then mark it.
calibration.horizontal_max.title: Horizontal: other end
calibration.horizontal_max.text: Now nudge it to the other end of its horizontal travel, again stopping just before anything touches, and mark it.
calibration.vertical_min.title: Vertical: first end
calibration.vertical_min.text: Nudge the arm toward one end of its vertical travel. Stop just before anything touches or strains, then mark it.
calibration.vertical_max.title: Vertical: other end
calibration.vertical_max.text: Now nudge it to the other end of its vertical travel and mark it.
calibration.stow.title: Stow position
calibration.stow.text: Nudge both axes to where the wand should rest when it is put away. The servos are released there, so pick a position where the arm stays put on its own.
calibration.sweep.title: Checking the envelope
calibration.sweep.text: Watch the robot: it slowly visits the four corners of the new limits, then returns to the Stow position. Press Cancel if anything touches.
calibration.confirm.title: Did everything stay clear?
calibration.confirm.text: If nothing touched or strained during the sweep, save the new limits. Otherwise start over.
calibration.done: Calibration saved. The robot now uses its new limits.
banner.uncalibrated: Not calibrated yet: movement is limited to a small safe range.
settings.limits.hint: Fine-tune the values found by Calibration. They apply once Calibration has been completed.
error.invalid_request: The robot did not understand the request.
settings.hardware.hint: Which GPIO drives each servo, its direction and its pulse range. Saving restarts the robot. Changing the direction or pulse range resets Calibration, since the limits would no longer match.
settings.restarting_recalibrate: Saved. The robot is restarting; run Calibration again afterwards.
error.pin_not_allowed: {axis}: this pin can't drive a servo on this chip.
error.pin_duplicate: Both servos can't use the same pin.
error.pulse_out_of_range: {axis}: pulses must be between 300 and 2700 µs, at least 500 µs apart.
settings.device.hint: The name also sets the robot's address and its hotspot's name. Saving restarts the robot.
settings.name: Name
settings.name_saved: Saved. The robot is restarting and will answer at http://{host}/
error.invalid_name: Use 1 to 32 characters, including at least one letter or digit.
info.title: Info
info.report: Include these details when you report a problem.
info.name: Name
diag.title: Diagnostic report
diag.hint: What the robot knows about itself, with your Wi-Fi name, addresses and broker details hidden. Attach it to a bug report: on GitHub or Discord it will be public.
diag.selected: Report selected: copy it with your browser.
diag.unavailable: The report could not be loaded. Check the connection to the robot.
diag.full.title: Full report, for your own use
diag.full.hint: Includes your Wi-Fi name, the IP and MAC addresses and the broker details. Keep it to yourself; never post it in public.
pin.title: Settings PIN
pin.text: Enter the robot's PIN to change its settings.
pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {seconds} s.
security.title: Settings PIN
security.hint: With a PIN, anyone on your Wi-Fi can still play and Stow, but changing limits, Calibration, wiring, name, Wi-Fi, Home Assistant or firmware asks for it. Forgot it? Erase and reflash the robot.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.
firmware.title: Firmware update
firmware.hint: Choose the .bin file for your chip from the latest release (the file whose name ends in -ota.bin). Settings and Calibration are kept. If the upload fails, the robot keeps its current firmware.
firmware.done: Installed. The robot is restarting; this page will reload.
error.not_firmware: This file is not an ESP32 firmware.
error.wrong_chip: This firmware is for another chip. Pick the file for your board's chip (see the Info page).
error.update_failed: The update failed. The robot keeps its current firmware.
error.upload_interrupted: The upload was interrupted. The robot keeps its current firmware; try again.
mqtt.title: Home Assistant
mqtt.hint: Connect the robot to the MQTT broker of your Home Assistant (for example the Mosquitto add-on). It then appears in Home Assistant by itself, with Stow, positions and maximum speeds. Leave it off if you don't use Home Assistant.
error.mqtt_port_invalid: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
mqtt.error.unreachable: Can't reach the broker. Check its address and port.
mqtt.error.bad_credentials: The broker refused the user or password.
